# Every directory with Go files in the main module, with its architecture role.
# TestKnownPackages fails on a directory missing here, so adding a package is a
# deliberate decision: add a line with the role that fits it.
#
# Format: <role> <path>. A path ending in /... covers the directory and below.
#
# core              the root package; imports no module package outside the leaf set
# leaf              a public package the core builds on; same import limits as the core
# feature           a feature subpackage split out of the root (arrayop, fts, ...); may
#                   import momo, the leaf set and internal/*, nothing else in the module
# internal-leaf     under internal/, must never depend on momo (the arrow is one-way)
# internal-fixture  under internal/, test and driver support that depends on momo by design
# other             tools, drivers, generators, migrations, examples; unconstrained here
#
# Each feature move story adds its package as a "feature" line.

core .
leaf dialect
leaf schema
leaf types
leaf vector

internal-leaf internal/chunk
internal-leaf internal/golden
internal-leaf internal/keyenc
internal-leaf internal/redact
internal-leaf internal/sqlscan
internal-leaf internal/sqliteconf
internal-leaf internal/sqlstub

internal-fixture internal/compat/...
internal-fixture internal/docscheck
internal-fixture internal/fakedriver
internal-fixture internal/obstest
internal-fixture internal/relfixture/...
internal-fixture internal/repocheck
internal-fixture internal/sqlmask
internal-fixture internal/sqlshared
internal-fixture internal/suite
internal-fixture internal/testdb/...
internal-fixture internal/testmodels/...
internal-fixture internal/vectorparity

other cmd/...
other driver/...
other examples/...
other gen/...
other importer/...
other migrate/...
other momolog
other momotest/...
other momovet
